shelly_cloud.help_title: How to find your Shelly Cloud auth key:
shelly_cloud.help_step_1: Open the Shelly Smart Control App or control.shelly.cloud.
shelly_cloud.help_step_2: Click on User Settings (Profile / Gear) at the bottom right.
shelly_cloud.help_step_3: Click on Authorization Cloud Key > Request / Show key.
shelly_cloud.help_step_4: Copy the long token displayed and paste it below.
shelly_cloud.help_tip: If you do not want to use cloud services at all (free & privacy-focused), simply use the Outbound WebSocket (WSS) method directly on the device as described above!
